cases.en: Have a lead researcher coordinate analysts, independently verify their sources and edit their findings into a referenced industry research report.
cases.zh: 由研究负责人组织分析员分工搜集行业资料，让审查者独立核实来源，再由编辑汇总为带出处的研究报告。

cases.en: For an ecommerce platform, run the complete architecture team workflow, handing artifacts between system design, infrastructure deployment and security specialists.
cases.zh: 为电商平台运行完整架构团队工作流，在系统设计、基础设施部署和安全专家之间交接设计产物。

cases.en: Measure API p95 under 200 concurrent clients, profile CPU and database waits, then demonstrate whether the proposed tuning actually improves throughput.
cases.zh: 测量200并发客户端下API的p95延迟，分析CPU与数据库等待，再证明调优是否真正提高吞吐量。

cases.en: Given order-payment business rules, derive traceable test scenarios for valid states, invalid transitions and boundary values before writing test code.
cases.zh: 根据订单支付业务规则，先推导可追溯的测试场景，覆盖合法状态、非法流转和边界值，暂不写测试代码。

cases.en: Build notification preferences using an end-to-end development orchestrator: clarify scope, split test-first implementation tasks, delegate, review specification compliance and code quality separately, then merge.
cases.zh: 通过完整开发编排器交付通知偏好功能：澄清范围、拆解先写测试的实现任务、委派执行、分别审查规格符合性与代码质量，最后合并。

cases.en: Translate the Chinese abstract and methods section of a scientific manuscript into publication-quality English without changing LaTeX notation or bibliography references.
cases.zh: 将科学论文的中文摘要和方法章节译成可发表的英文，不要改动LaTeX符号和参考文献标记。

cases.en: Use browser automation against my localhost shopping app to test adding an item and checking out; retain visual evidence and any JavaScript console failures.
cases.zh: 用浏览器自动化测试localhost购物应用的加购与结账过程，保留视觉证据和JavaScript控制台异常。

cases.en: Read the tables in these PDF statements and produce another PDF containing only pages two through five in the specified order.
cases.zh: 读取这些PDF账单里的表格，再按指定顺序生成一份仅含第2至5页的新PDF。

cases.en: Deliver an .xlsx monthly income and expense model with SUM formulas, number formats and verified recalculated totals rather than hardcoded answers.
cases.zh: 交付.xlsx月度收支模型，用SUM公式和数值格式，并验证重算的合计，不要把答案写死。

cases.en: Our five-day trip has a total spending ceiling. Allocate the allowance across transport, hotels, food and attractions and decide what to downgrade when the plan exceeds it.
cases.zh: 五天旅行有总花费上限，请在交通、酒店、餐饮和景点间分配额度，超出时判断哪些项目降档或取舍。

cases.en: Look up the official current FastAPI documentation and version-compatible dependency-injection examples using a live documentation connector.
cases.zh: 通过实时开发文档连接器查找FastAPI官方当前文档和兼容指定版本的依赖注入示例。

cases.en: Connect to GitHub and list open pull requests and unresolved issues for a repository, using its MCP service rather than a browser scrape.
cases.zh: 连接GitHub，通过其MCP服务列出仓库未合并的PR和未解决的issue，不要抓取网页。

cases.en: Retrieve the project decision document from my Notion workspace: search the pages first, then read the matching page through the service API.
cases.zh: 从我的Notion工作区取出项目决策文档：先搜索页面，再通过服务API读取匹配页面。

cases.en: Which HR MCP integration handles employee social-security contributions and housing-fund benefits administration?
cases.zh: 哪个人事MCP集成可以处理员工社会保险缴纳和住房公积金福利管理？

limitations: Independent paraphrases of the same fourteen target capabilities, frozen after the runtime fix and before querying; not a new-domain benchmark
No target labels are injected into scoring and no original module prompt is rewritten
Small identity-labelled test: relevant alternative resources are not counted as target hits
